articles.body:
Hello,

The grantee list exported to Excel turns åäö into strange character pairs. "Bröderna Öberg" becomes something unreadable. It looked fine last spring.

Kind regards,
Gustav Ebbe
articles.subject: Excel export of grantees mangles Swedish characters

articles.body:
Hi Gustav,

Are you opening the file directly in Excel, or importing it? We send UTF-8 CSV, and Excel on Windows assumes the old Windows encoding unless the file carries a byte order mark.

We can add the byte order mark to the export, which makes Excel open it correctly on double-click. I have asked for it to be added.

Best,
Mia
articles.subject: Re: Excel export of grantees mangles Swedish characters

articles.body:
The new export opens correctly, names look right. Thank you for the quick turn.

Gustav Ebbe
Director, Ebbahus Stiftelse
